thread:
Jules: heads up — new KMS/Vault combination policy landed in prod at 2026-06-10 14:00 UTC, seeing a bunch of bootstrap 403s from gpu nodes in us-east-1 and ca-central-1.
Arjun: confirmed. autoscaler spun extra nodes trying to meet prewarm; costs spiked. ops-bot posted alert.
ops-bot: Cost alert: GPU spend +140% vs baseline (us-east-1).
Jules: sample error from node-init:
```
2026-06-10T14:02:11Z node-init error: vault read 403 path=secret/data/prod/kms/agent-token
policy="kms-tight-2026-06-10" reason="principal not authorized"
```
Tara (security): that policy tightened IAM->Vault role bindings to require CI-signed certs. artifact-service still using token-based role, so bootstrap fails. I didn't expect agent rollout to hit this path.
Arjun: net effect: nodes can't decrypt model shards (KMS unwrap fails) so kube join fails and warm pools stay low. autoscaler keeps launching -> spot fallback -> cost.
Jules: can we short-circuit by letting nodes use the last-known-good envelope key cached on warm nodes? risky but might reduce churn.
Tara (security): prefer a minimal-scope fallback: temporarily add the artifact-service role to the new policy allowlist and create ephemeral tokens, log exception. I'll author the emergency exception now.
Arjun: commands I used (dry-run then apply):
```
vault policy write prod-agent-fallback - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/kms/agent-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=prod-agent-fallback -orphan -ttl=2h
kubectl -n infra create secret generic fallback-agent-token --from-literal=token=<token>
```
Jules: token injected, some nodes finished bootstrap and joined warm pool. prewarm back to ~75% in 18m. cost alert downgraded at 14:25.
Marta (compliance): audit question: was the audit-shipper running during the policy push? we need to capture who/what changed policy and any vault access logs.
Tara (security): audit-shipper was paused briefly to reduce noise during rollout — that's on me. we'll re-enable now and document gap. opening compliance ticket and emergency exception.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0610-KMS-POLICY recorded. Linked ticket PLT-9981.
Jules: follow-ups: (1) add role-check smoke test to KMS/Vault rollout, (2) include warm-node cache fallback as a validation step, (3) require two-person approval before pausing audit exporters. creating PLT-9982.
